data: What is the WER value of the orange line in the left graph at a beam width of 512

The orange line represents the CTC method. The left graph shows the WER values for both CTC and CTC-C with different beam widths. At a beam width of 512, the orange line (CTC) is approximately at 13.20%. Therefore, the WER value of the orange line in the left graph at a beam width of 512 is around 13.20%.
